edges.reason: transfer() delegates balance movement to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() first invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom() rewrites the allowance through _approve.
approve() delegates to the internal _approve writer.
increaseAllowance() writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance() writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transfer triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, a user-overridable callback.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_burn triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ERC20 base constructor with name and symbol.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the payable ServicePayer constructor with the fee receiver.
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to an attacker-supplied receiver contract.
The external call resolves into the untrusted IPayable.pay implementation.
msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender().
msg.sender becomes the mint recipient of the entire token supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the debit source of transfer().
_msgSender() supplies the sender address to _transfer.
_msgSender() supplies the owner address to _approve.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
recipient address indexes the credited _balances entry.
amount drives the balance subtraction and require check in _transfer.
sender parameter is used for the allowance lookup in transferFrom().
sender parameter is the debited account inside _transfer.
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve().
spender parameter keys the allowance update in increaseAllowance().
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup in decreaseAllowance().
addedValue flows into the allowance addition expression.
subtractedValue flows into the allowance subtraction expression.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping read.
name_ argument is stored into the _name state variable.
symbol_ argument is stored into the _symbol state variable.
initialBalance_ is validated and then passed to _mint.
initialBalance_ becomes the minted amount credited to msg.sender.
feeReceiver_ is the target address of the payable external call.
feeReceiver_ is cast to IPayable and invoked with msg.value.
Cached currentAllowance is the left operand of the allowance subtraction in transferFrom().
transferFrom() reads the stored allowance into the currentAllowance local.
amount is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom().
Cached senderBalance is decremented by amount inside _transfer.
_transfer() caches _balances[sender] into senderBalance.
_transfer() credits the recipient balance by amount.
_transfer() writes the debited and credited _balances entries.
_mint() adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint() credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn() reduces _totalSupply.
_approve() writes the nested _allowances mapping.
Cached currentAllowance is the left operand of the decreaseAllowance subtraction.
decreaseAllowance() caches the caller allowance into a local variable.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance in decreaseAllowance().
increaseAllowance() adds addedValue to the stored allowance.
name() returns the _name state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address parameter only used to forward tokens through transfer().
Amount parameter exists solely to drive the balance update performed by transfer().
Source address parameter is consumed by transferFrom() for the allowance and balance operations.
Spender parameter is the allowance key handled by approve().
Value is only meaningful inside the increaseAllowance() allowance addition.
Value is only meaningful inside the decreaseAllowance() allowance subtraction.
Address parameter exists only to index the mapping read in balanceOf().
Constructor string is immediately stored into the _name state variable by the base constructor.
Constructor string is immediately stored into the _symbol state variable by the base constructor.
Supply argument is validated and minted within the SimpleERC20 constructor flow.
Receiver argument is only used as the target of the payable external call in the constructor.
Local allowance cache lives entirely inside transferFrom() and its subtraction operation.
Local balance cache exists only for the subtraction performed inside _transfer().
Local allowance cache exists only for the subtraction performed inside decreaseAllowance().
